categories.whyZh: 做決定、遇到卡關的事時，妳通常怎麼想、怎麼做？這部分會陪妳看看自己的判斷方式，以及什麼會影響妳的選擇。
categories.whyEn: How do you think things through and act when a decision is difficult? This area explores your approach to decisions and what influences your choices.
categories.practicalZh: 查資訊、比較做法，以及把想法付諸行動。
categories.innerZh: 自己的想法、直覺、期待，以及面對不確定時的感受。
categories.practicalEn: Checking information, weighing options and putting plans into practice.
categories.innerEn: Your preferences, intuition, expectations and feelings about uncertainty.

categories.whyZh: 妳怎麼照顧自己，又怎麼表達自己的喜好？這部分也會看看，別人的眼光會怎麼影響妳。
categories.whyEn: How do you care for yourself and express what you like? This area also explores how other people’s opinions affect you.
categories.practicalZh: 基本照顧、穿著、生活空間和喜歡的創作。
categories.innerZh: 對自己的欣賞，以及面對稱讚、比較或批評時的感受。
categories.practicalEn: Personal care, clothing, your surroundings and creative activities you enjoy.
categories.innerEn: Self-appreciation and how you respond to praise, comparison or criticism.

categories.whyZh: 最近身體和心裡還好嗎？這部分會看看睡眠、飲食、活動和情緒，以及妳需要休息或幫忙時，能不能照顧到自己。
categories.whyEn: How have you been feeling physically and emotionally? This area looks at sleep, food, movement, feelings, and whether you can get rest or support when you need it.
categories.practicalZh: 作息、吃飯、身體活動和取得照顧的情況。
categories.innerZh: 察覺感受、消化情緒，以及說出界線和需要。
categories.practicalEn: Daily routines, meals, physical activity and access to care.
categories.innerEn: Recognising feelings, working through emotions and communicating limits and needs.

categories.whyZh: 這裡想了解的，不只是妳有多少錢，而是妳怎麼安排手上的資源，以及金錢帶給妳什麼感受。
categories.whyEn: This area looks at how you manage the resources available to you and how money affects you, beyond the amount you have.
categories.practicalZh: 必要開銷、消費和資源變動時的安排。
categories.innerZh: 金錢壓力、比較，以及自己的價值和界線。
categories.practicalEn: Essential expenses, spending and adapting when resources change.
categories.innerEn: Money worries, comparison, self-worth and boundaries.

categories.whyZh: 妳怎麼學習、發揮長處，又怎麼看待自己和別人的相處？這部分也會看看，什麼讓妳的生活有方向、有意義。
categories.whyEn: How do you learn, use your strengths and relate to others? This area also explores what gives your life direction and meaning.
categories.practicalZh: 學習、運用長處、幫忙，以及回應別人的意見。
categories.innerZh: 反覆遇到的模式、對彼此的期待，以及自己看重的信念與方向。
categories.practicalEn: Learning, using strengths, helping others and responding to feedback.
categories.innerEn: Recurring patterns, expectations of others, and the beliefs and direction that matter to you.

step.zh: 選一件正在猶豫的事，確認可用資訊，再選一個這週能完成的小步驟。
step.en: Choose one pending decision, check available information and choose a small step for this week.

step.zh: 選一項可以減少、延後或請人協助的安排。留意一次失誤是否被當成對整個自己的評價。
step.en: Choose one task to reduce, postpone or ask for help with. Notice whether one mistake becomes a judgment of your whole self.

step.zh: 選一個安全、合適的對象，說明一項具體需要，或提出一個自己能負擔的安排。
step.en: With a safe, appropriate person, express one specific need or propose an arrangement within your capacity.

step.zh: 選一個不增加支出的日常選擇，練習依自己的喜好決定。
step.en: Practise making one everyday choice based on your own preferences, without extra spending.

step.zh: 先找出一項最難維持的休息或照顧安排，看看能否減少負擔或取得協助。
step.en: Identify one difficult rest or care arrangement and consider reducing the burden or finding support.

step.zh: 先分清楚是難以辨認情緒、難以緩和，還是不容易表達需要，再選一個可行的小步驟。
step.en: First distinguish difficulty naming feelings, settling them or expressing needs, then choose a feasible step.

step.zh: 先確認必要支出與可用資源。資源不足不等於不會理財，也不代表個人價值。
step.en: Check essential expenses and available resources. Limited resources do not imply poor financial skill or lower personal worth.

step.zh: 回想一件最近對妳有意義的小事，選擇一個符合自己意願、時間與資源的下一步。
step.en: Recall one recent meaningful action and choose a next step that fits your wishes, time and resources.

text.zh: 如果想進一步探索自己的想法，可以先了解「塔囉聊心」，再決定是否適合。
text.en: If you want to explore your personal question, you can ask about Xian Tian Tarot before deciding whether it fits.

text.zh: 如果想探索一個具體的抉擇，可以先了解「易經解困」，與我們確認是否適合。
text.en: If you want to explore a specific decision, ask us whether an I Ching Reading fits your question.

text.zh: 若想安排身體放鬆體驗，可以先了解「刀式舒壓」，並與我們確認服務方式與身體狀況是否合適。
text.en: If you want a body relaxation experience, ask about Knife Therapy and discuss whether the approach suits your circumstances.

text.zh: 若想留一段時間慢下來，可以先了解「芬多精療癒」的放鬆體驗，再決定是否安排。
text.en: If you want time to slow down, you can ask about the Phytoncide Healing relaxation experience before deciding.
